events.title: Medieval Ascendant: Demo v0.6.0
events.summary: What's new in demo:Fog of war on the world map: clouds cover unexplored land, sight range two hexes, taverns reveal the surroundingsLiving world map: caravans, travel events, innsSieges rebuilt: garrison decides the wall fight, champion duel opens the breach, starvation from real province food stocks, working sallies, repelled sieges stay broken for a seasonReadable warfare: personal siege missions, per-side season loss forecast, war duration in the treatySave profiles, hard saves, slot renaming

events.title: Major Update 0.4.0
events.summary: What's new in demo:Walk or ride the world map yourself - right-click to travel, with waymarks for bandit camps, trade caravans, and farms along the roadsHouse wars now play out visibly on the world map. Marching regiments, house crests on every banner, siege camps at the wallsWars run exactly the same whether you fight in them or just watch; Same armies, same battles, same courseAuto-sell checkbox on your businesses, plus "sell all" buttons in the warehouseSmithing without caps - set workpieces

events.title: Major Update 0.3.0
events.summary: The map is the game now. Instead of clicking through menu screens, you live on the province map in full view. The realm map is the zoomed-out overview; everything else opens as an overlay on top.A unified visual language. All windows, panels, and popups now follow the same style. Consistent frames, consistent calm. Popups anchor to the clicked object and can be freely dragged.Always have a look at the world. events.title: The Fair has arrived!
events.summary: Big update today - the Fair Trade is live! Every autumn, a travelling fair may roll into your province, and trust us: you'll want to be there.Here's what's waiting for you between the tents and torchlight:Market stalls - 4 traders with rotating wares, from bargain bundles to rare masterwork pieces. Every year's offers are unique, so keep your coin purse ready.Pets! - Yes, really. Adopt a loyal dog, a clever cat, or a mighty horse.
